description: This file contains FastAPI route handlers and utility functions for provider-specific pass-through endpoints in a large language model proxy framework. It manages proxy routing for various LLM providers including Anthropic, Vertex AI, Cohere, Mistral, Milvus, Bedrock, AssemblyAI, Azure, and OpenAI. The code includes logic for dynamically constructing target URLs, handling streaming requests, managing authentication headers, and processing requests for both direct API calls and router-based models, with special handling for certain model types like Bedrock and Vertex AI.
